card: Look for food by nutrient, feeling or time of day.
title: Eat This when food is the question
intro: Eat This starts with the question you have about food — a nutrient, a feeling or the time of day — then lets you compare one serving.

sections.heading: How can you look for food?
sections.body: Start with a nutrient, a feeling or a time of day. The food search follows that question.

sections.heading: What does a serving show?
sections.body: The result shows what one serving contributes, so the amount has context.

sections.heading: When should the question go elsewhere?
sections.body: It points out a cheaper pick and says when a question belongs with a doctor.

sections.heading: Where does Eat This fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps food entries beside the rest of your record. Eat This starts with a question about what to eat and what one serving gives.
